_comment: Which model fills which role. Swap a value; nothing else changes.

_yolox_comment: YOLOX (Megvii), Apache-2.0, COCO class 14 = bird. ONNX Runtime on CPU,
CoreML EP used when present. Models cached in pipeline/models/.
conf 0.15 is a cost-asymmetry choice, not a fit to logs/bird-log.md: a
distant bird the sweep misses is invisible forever, a false positive
costs one glance at a crop. Raise it for a cleaner working set; lower it
before ever concluding a frame is birdless.
tile 1200 with overlap 0.25 sweeps 24 MP frames at native resolution.
whole_frame adds one letterboxed pass for birds too big for a tile.
